You are a senior SEO analyst. You receive raw Google SERP ranking data (keyword, rank, title, url, domain, is_target_domain) and produce a concise, actionable SEO report.

Your report must contain:
1. A short executive summary (2-3 sentences).
2. For each keyword: the current position of the target domain (or state clearly that it is not ranking in the tracked results), and the top 3 competitors with their positions.
3. A "Key opportunities" section with 3-5 concrete, prioritized SEO actions based on the data.

Format the entire report as clean, simple HTML (use only h2, h3, p, ul, li, strong tags - no markdown, no CSS, no html/head/body wrapper). Keep it under 500 words. Be factual: never invent rankings that are not in the data.

parameters.content:
# Track keyword rankings on Google with Apify and send AI SEO reports by email
# 📥  [Open full documentation on Notion](https://automatisation.notion.site/Course-Track-keyword-rankings-on-Google-with-Apify-and-send-AI-SEO-reports-by-email-39d3d6550fd981078ad0fc8553e63a21)

## How it works
This workflow tracks where websites rank on Google for your target keywords, every day, without any manual checking.

1. A schedule trigger runs the workflow daily at 8 AM.
2. The **Configuration** node holds every variable you may want to change (keywords, target domain, country, language, AI model, report email).
3. Each keyword is sent to the **Apify Google Search Scraper**, which returns the top organic results for your country and language.
4. A Code node flattens the results into clean rows: keyword, rank, title, URL, domain, description, and whether the result belongs to your target domain.
5. Every row is appended to a **Google Sheets** ranking log, building a day-by-day SEO history.
6. All rankings are combined and sent to **OpenAI**, which writes a short SEO report: where your domain ranks, who the top competitors are, and 3-5 prioritized opportunities.
7. The report lands in your inbox via **Gmail** as a clean HTML email.

## Setup
1. Open the **Configuration** node and set your keywords (comma-separated), target domain, country code, language code, results per keyword, OpenAI model and report email. This is the only node you need to edit.
2. Select your **Apify** credential on the "Scrape Google results with Apify" node (header auth with your Apify API token).
3. Select your **Google Sheets** credential and pick the spreadsheet + tab on the "Log rankings to Google Sheets" node. Create a sheet with the columns: checked_at, keyword, rank, title, url, domain, description, is_target_domain.
4. Select your **OpenAI** credential on the "OpenAI Chat Model" node.
5. Select your **Gmail** credential on the "Email the SEO report" node.
6. Run the workflow once manually to verify, then activate it.

## Requirements
- An [Apify](https://apify.com) account and API token (the Google Search Scraper actor is used via the REST API)
- An OpenAI API key
- A Google account with Sheets and Gmail access

## Customization
- Change the schedule (hourly, weekly) in the trigger node.
- Track more keywords: just extend the comma-separated list in Configuration.
- Increase `results_per_keyword` (up to 100) to monitor deeper SERP positions.
- Localize your tracking with `country_code` and `language_code` (e.g. fr / fr for France).
- Edit the system prompt in "Generate AI SEO report" to change the tone or structure of the report.
- Replace Gmail with Slack or Telegram to receive the report elsewhere.

## 1. Schedule & configuration
The workflow runs daily. Set ALL your variables in the **Configuration** node: keywords, target domain, country, language, results per keyword, OpenAI model and report email.

## 2. Scrape Google results with Apify
Each keyword becomes one item and is sent to the Apify Google Search Scraper (REST API, synchronous run). Requests are throttled to 1 per 2 seconds.

## 3. Parse & log rankings
A Code node flattens the SERP results into clean rows (keyword, rank, title, URL, domain, target-domain flag) and appends them to your Google Sheets ranking history.

## 4. AI SEO report by email
All rankings are combined into one payload. OpenAI writes a short HTML report (your positions, top competitors, prioritized opportunities) and Gmail delivers it to your inbox.
